summary:
[  edit  ]
The Tube  SOP  generates open or closed tubes, cones, or pyramids along the X, Y or Z axes. It outputs as meshes, polygons or simply a tube  Primitive .

parameters.label: Primitive  Type
parameters.name: type
parameters.description: ⊞  - Select from the following types. For information on the different types, see the  Geometry  category articles. Using the ' Primitive ' primitive type is not recommended when using instancing.

parameters.label: Connectivity
parameters.name: surftype
parameters.description: ⊞  - This option is used to select the type of surface, when using a Mesh  Primitive  Type.

parameters.label: Rows
parameters.name: rows
parameters.description: Creates horizontal lines.

parameters.label: Columns
parameters.name: cols
parameters.description: Creates vertical lines.

parameters.label: Rows and Columns
parameters.name: rowcol
parameters.description: Both Rows and Columns. Looks like Quads in wire frame display, but all polygons are open (if the primitive type is polygon).

parameters.label: Triangles
parameters.name: triangles
parameters.description: Build the grid with Triangles.

parameters.label: Quadrilaterals
parameters.name: quads
parameters.description: Generates sides composed of quadrilaterals (default).

parameters.label: Alternating Triangles
parameters.name: alttriangles
parameters.description: Generates triangles that are opposed; similar to the Triangles option.

parameters.label: Orientation
parameters.name: orient
parameters.description: ⊞  - Primary axis of tube (long axis).

parameters.label: Orient Bounds
parameters.name: orientbounds
parameters.description: Available only when an input is connected to the Tube  SOP  to set bounds for the tube. When Orient Bounds = On it will rotate the geometry to match the orientation of the input  SOP  used for bounds.

parameters.label: Modify Bounds
parameters.name: modifybounds
parameters.description: Enabled only when an input is connected to the Tube  SOP  to set bounds for the tube. Turn Modify Bounds = On to enable the transform parameters below to further modify the position, scale, radius and height of the bounds.

parameters.label: Rotate Order
parameters.name: rord
parameters.description: ⊞  - Sets the order in which the rotations are applied.

parameters.label: Center
parameters.name: t
parameters.description: ⊞  - Location of the tube center from the object origin.

parameters.label: Rotate
parameters.name: r
parameters.description: ⊞  - These three fields rotate the Tube along the X, Y, and Z axes.

parameters.label: Radius
parameters.name: rad
parameters.description: ⊞  - The first field is the radius of the top of the tube and the second field represents the radius of the bottom of the tube.

parameters.label: Height
parameters.name: height
parameters.description: The height of the tube.

parameters.label: Reverse Anchors
parameters.name: reverseanchors
parameters.description: Invert the direction of anchors.

parameters.label: Anchor U
parameters.name: anchoru
parameters.description: Set the point in X about which the geometry is positioned, scaled and rotated.

parameters.label: Anchor V
parameters.name: anchorv
parameters.description: Set the point in Y about which the geometry is positioned, scaled and rotated.

parameters.label: Anchor W
parameters.name: anchorw
parameters.description: Set the point in Z about which the geometry is positioned, scaled and rotated.

parameters.label: Imperfect
parameters.name: imperfect
parameters.description: This option applies only to Bezier and NURBS types. If selected, the tube is an approximated nonrational curve, otherwise it is a perfect rational curve.

parameters.label: Rows
parameters.name: rows
parameters.description: Number of rows in tube.

parameters.label: Columns
parameters.name: cols
parameters.description: Number of columns in tube.

parameters.label: U Order
parameters.name: orderu
parameters.description: If a spline surface is selected, it is built at this order for U.

parameters.label: V Order
parameters.name: orderv
parameters.description: If a spline surface is selected, it is built at this order for V.

parameters.label: End Caps
parameters.name: cap
parameters.description: If selected, it adds faceted end caps to the ends of the tube.

parameters.label: Texture Coordinates
parameters.name: texture
parameters.description: ⊞  - Adds UV texture coordinates to the sphere.

parameters.label: Off
parameters.name: off
parameters.description: No UV coordinates added to surface.

parameters.label: Row & Columns
parameters.name: rowcol
parameters.description: Adds vertex UV coordinates.

parameters.label: Compute Normals
parameters.name: normals
parameters.description: Checking this option On will compute surface normals.

parameters.label: num_points
parameters.description: Number of points in this  SOP .

parameters.label: num_prims
parameters.description: Number of primitives in this  SOP .

parameters.label: num_particles
parameters.description: Number of particles in this  SOP .

parameters.label: last_vbo_update_time
parameters.description: Time spent in another thread updating geometry data on the  GPU  from the  SOP 's CPU data. As it is part of another thread, this time is not part of the usual frame time.

parameters.label: last_meta_vbo_update_time
parameters.description: Time spent in another thread updating meta surface geometry data (such as metaballs or nurbs) on the  GPU  from the  SOP 's CPU data. As it is part of another thread, this time is not part of the usual frame time.

parameters.label: total_cooks
parameters.description: Number of times the operator has cooked since the process started.

parameters.label: cook_time
parameters.description: Duration of the last cook in milliseconds.

parameters.label: cook_frame
parameters.description: Frame number when this operator was last cooked relative to the component timeline.

parameters.label: cook_abs_frame
parameters.description: Frame number when this operator was last cooked relative to the absolute time.

parameters.label: cook_start_time
parameters.description: Time in milliseconds at which the operator started cooking in the frame it was cooked.

parameters.label: cook_end_time
parameters.description: Time in milliseconds at which the operator finished cooking in the frame it was cooked.

parameters.label: cooked_this_frame
parameters.description: 1 if operator was cooked this frame.

parameters.label: warnings
parameters.description: Number of warnings in this operator if any.

parameters.label: errors
parameters.description: Number of errors in this operator if any.

parameters.label: A polygon is a type of  Primitive  that is formed from a set of  Vertices  in 3D that are implicitly connected together to form a multi
parameters.description: edge shape.

parameters.label: The Graphics Processing Unit. This is the high
parameters.description: speed, many-core processor of the graphics card/chip that takes geometry, images and data from the CPU and creates images and processed data.

**Uso simple:** Para importar geometrías o nubes de puntos creadas en otros softwares o generadas a partir de datos externos. * **Point Generator POP (POP Generador de Puntos)** * **Función principal:** Crea un número específico de puntos, de forma aleatoria o con un patrón, sobre la **superficie** o dentro del **volumen** de una forma matemática básica (esfera, cubo, toro, etc.). * **Características clave:** * Permite elegir la **forma base** (Sphere, Box, Torus, Tube, Rectangle, Circle, Line). * Puedes generar puntos en la **superficie** o dentro del **volumen** de la forma. * Ofrece un control de `Random` (aleatoriedad) y `Seed` (semilla para el patrón aleatorio). * Capaz de añadir **normales (`N`) y tangentes (`T`)** a los puntos, vértices o primitivas, con opciones de aleatorización. * **Uso simple:** Una manera fácil de crear nubes de puntos o distribuir elementos en formas geométricas básicas para simulaciones o
